# 幕末「フォロー・ザ・マネー」読解室 — Ver 0.4
Canonical: https://www.aiofonesown.com/lab/bakumatsu/
Language: ja-JP
Published: 2026-09-18
Updated: 2026-09-19
Publisher: AI NOBORU / Noboru Ikuta

## Scope
1830年代〜1888年を射程に、主分析を1859–1876年へ置く。富の源泉、貨幣発行益、現金化・外貨、信用・決済、海外調達、政治・物流、最終負担の7層で追跡。

## Ver 0.4 integration
- Ver 0.22 correction audit: MS JM/A8/112/7, 11,900 rifles vs famous 7,300 subset, converted warship values, Satsuma account-name caveat, 1865 date inferred from 1866 memo.
- Losing-side view: shogunate, Ouetsu research agenda, Stonewall/Kotetsu neutrality.
- International comparison: Egypt, Ottoman Empire, Qing Customs, Japan; institutional differences are preserved.
- Horatio Nelson Lay: first Inspector General of the Chinese Maritime Customs and party to Japan's 1869 £1m / 12% contract.
- Takashima: British commercial-credit continuity into Meiji; exact debt/loss figures remain pending primary verification.

## Core finding
No direct evidence currently establishes one lump-sum British-government revolutionary fund to Satsuma/Choshu. Domestic purchasing power, commercial credit, political/logistical cover, international procurement and final burden are separated. Account labels are not treated as proof of economic destination.

## Evidence discipline
Claim status and source grade are separate. 81 source records. Comparative claims are not used as one-cause explanations. Unverified totals remain open questions.
